subject.title: Clarify or update bundled Ollama Cloud MiniMax static default model

question: Should the bundled outage fallback track the newest supported MiniMax cloud generation, or deliberately retain MiniMax M2.7 until a separate stability promotion?
rationale: Both M2.7 and M3 remain available upstream, while OpenClaw normally uses live discovery; selecting the model shown only when discovery fails is a provider recommendation and compatibility-policy choice rather than a mechanically provable bug fix.

options.title: Promote MiniMax M3
options.body: Verify the hosted API entry and replace M2.7 with M3 across static capabilities, manifest metadata, fallback tests, and provider docs.

options.title: Retain MiniMax M2.7
options.body: Keep the established fallback and document that fallback rows prioritize proven stability rather than following every live-catalog generation.

options.title: Offer Both Models
options.body: Add M3 without removing M2.7 and define deterministic ordering, accepting a larger fallback catalog and continuing maintenance burden.

recommendation.title: Promote MiniMax M3
recommendation.body: Verify the hosted API entry and replace M2.7 with M3 across static capabilities, manifest metadata, fallback tests, and provider docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows the clearest available reviewer and landing involvement in Ollama Cloud provider behavior.
